description: Every coordinated buy cluster on a Robinhood Chain token in a window, the launch bundle AND groups that buy together later (rhc_token_bundle only scores the first-20 cohort). A cluster = one block where >= min_wallets distinct effective trading accounts (ERC-4337 senders resolved) bought. Per cluster: block_number, at, minutes_after_launch + phase (launch = within 5 min of first sighting, else later), wallet_count, new_wallets (no earlier buy of the token), same_tx_groups (txs carrying 3+ of them; WEAKER evidence than on Solana because a 4337 bundler batches unrelated userOps), eth_volume, token_volume_raw (uint256 string), wallets (<= 50), and exit (what those wallets have SOLD since, from the live bundle tracker; null when the cluster is not followed). summary.baseline = buys per active block (busy tokens share blocks innocently): evidence, not a verdict. include_balances adds held_now for the 3 most recent clusters. 503 bundle_clusters_unavailable until the server function exists. Tier: PRO+.

include_balances.description: Add held_now (balanceOf) to the 3 most recent clusters

min_wallets.description: Minimum distinct buyers in one block (default 3)

name: rhc_token_bundles
